Rationale: Personality, friendly/helpful and explicit be-kind-to contexts establish the interpersonal adjective sense.
Explicit many kinds of plus animal/food taxonomy neighborhoods establish the noun sense 'type/kind'.
Remaining flat-list contexts do not safely distinguish the friendly adjective from the type noun. Hold rather than guess.
Write/keep-in-touch/message contexts establish letter as a written message sent to someone.
The letter/spell neighborhood supports the alphabet-character sense.
Remaining rows are flat or weakly bound and cannot safely distinguish mail from alphabet-character usage.
Garden/leaf/water/grow, crop/soil and root/branch neighborhoods establish the physical plant noun.
Base/past verb pairing and explicit plant trees / Tree Planting Day contexts establish the planting action.
Remaining flat-list contexts cannot reliably distinguish the plant noun from the planting verb; no factory sense is inferred from the dictionary gloss.
Left/right, turn right, map and route contexts establish the spatial/directional sense.
That's right and explicit right/wrong feedback contexts establish the correctness sense.
Remaining flat-list rows do not safely distinguish directional right from correctness or other dictionary senses.
Hear/voice, wind-bell, quiet/loud/noisy and ringing contexts establish the audible-sound noun.
Remaining rows may contain the linking verb 'sound' or the noun, but the flat-list windows do not justify a complete disjoint sense assignment.
